summary: Deliverable is a single stdlib Python file `open_copy_model.py` implementing the restricted event/handshake/capacity/exit model required by out/innovation-rescue-20261009/model-implementation-contract.md. It models two copy flows A and V that share one physical source PA: per-flow B-beat payload FIFOs, one shared single-beat skid with required/delivered masks, an ordered write-owner queue, per-band AW first-offer/held-header non-retraction, per-sink RVALID/RREADY returned cursor, one WLAST and one B per W burst, and one parent RLAST per flow. Five controllers share the same data path: independent_long, naive_long_lockstep (defect reproduction), closed_short_long_read, ordinary_tile_exit, open_long_read. A pause is applied except for the initial common band, A exit/resume uses the actual returned cursor and an independent child read that rebuilds the parent RLAST, and every outcome is read back from event state (FIFO occupancy, skid mask, queue head, counters). The scan covers N=8/9/16/17, B=2/3, q=1/2 (q<=B), pause P=0/1/q/q+1/N-1, plus permanent-pause runs and four pure-state probes (held R, held AW, delivered-mask de-duplication, admission cert guard). No cycles/PTW/TL/RTL/area numbers are produced; no baseline/candidate outcome is hardcoded. I could not execute anything, so no test-pass claim is made; the static reasoning of the primary and held-valid traces and known residual risks are in `assumptions` and `unresolved`.
assumptions: The two copy jobs A and V have the same 8B-aligned source PA, immutable plain memory, INCR, and non-overlapping destinations; permission/mapping stability is a premise, not executed. The model never simulates TL/PTW.
All payload is deterministic and non-repeating (value = 0x100000 + 0x111*i) for 0 <= i < 256, so beat-for-beat comparison is meaningful.

The simplified first-version band rule from the contract is used: one outstanding AW per flow, q <= B, and band k+1 is committed only after band k completes for all currently-bound members. For closed_short_long_read the cross-flow lockstep is unconditional; for ordinary_tile_exit and open_long_read it applies only while A is active, so V can continue once A is paused/exited.
The shared physical source is a single port; read jobs are serviced one at a time and the single-beat shared skid releases a beat only when every sink in the fixed required mask has handshaked it.

open_long_read mask rule: V is required while V has coverage; A is required only for physical indices below A's already-offered W coverage, so A is never given an RVALID it has not already committed, and a held A RVALID is never withdrawn. After A pauses, A finishes its current band, exits at the actual returned cursor D, V continues, and A later re-reads [D,N) from its returned cursor, rebuilding exactly one parent RLAST.

The 'naive必死/候选必胜' results are read back from event state (FIFO occupancy, skid mask, write-queue head, remaining band beats, no advancing event). Nothing is written as a fixed verdict; the `expected` flag only keeps an intended structural negative (naive lockstep, permanent-pause closed) from turning the suite exit code non-zero.

static primary-trace reasoning (N=16,B=3,q=2,open, P=1): band0 offered by both, beat0/beat1 delivered to both, A pauses at returned=1, A completes band0 and exits at D=2; V keeps the same N-beat physical burst with mask {V} past index 2, offers bands 2,3,... and finishes; at t=200 A resumes, issues a solo child read [2,16), completes. phys_beats should be N + (N-D) = 30 = 2N-D.

static held-valid trace: when A's RVALID is up and A RREADY=0 at the pause, the beat, mask and delivered bits are unchanged; on the later READY exactly one A handshake occurs, the beat releases, and the following beat may exit for A. This is implemented positionally in probe_held_r_valid and structurally in the skid delivered-mask logic.
The model reports model events, not platform cycles; phys_beats / phys_ar / header counts are model counters, not speedup.
unresolved: I could not execute the file; all outcome statements above are static reasoning or design intent, not measured runs.

intimate cross-band behavior of closed_short_long_read after resume depends on the unconditional cross-flow lockstep choice; the trace recovers in the derivation, but I have not observed it. If the run shows a residual structural stall after resume, the honest fallback is to report it as a real counterexample with the stall snapshot instead of weakening assertions.

open_long_read vs ordinary_tile_exit: with A exiting at the same returned cursor D, the model can yield the same source-beat count (2N-D); the intended difference is physical AR count/header fragmentation only, not a cycle-advantage claim.
The first version does not model a V long-W re-expansion after A exits (the contract's q-band simplified first version keeps q bands); the design doc's 'V恢复长burst' is not modelled.
No live invalidation / mutable-input case is modelled; MMIO, atomic, exclusive, MRIF and error cases are excluded by premise.

Bits/field estimation for candidate extra state is not emitted as a synthesis area; the model only names the hardware fields its Python logic represents (per-flow FIFO, offered_end/bands_completed, returned cursor, held band, skid mask/delivered, child-read start).
